description: Search RUAGENTIC listings by words, with optional filters. Use when someone asks for an MCP server, client, AI agent, skill, plugin, rules file or eval for a task, a product, a category or a platform. Returns ranked listings with public GitHub stars, launch date and listing URL. server = MCP server, client = MCP client, product = AI agent, skill = Agent Skills package (SKILL.md), plugin = plugin or extension for an agent host, rules = rules or instruction file (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .cursorrules), eval = benchmark or evaluation set.

category.description: A category name from directory_overview, e.g. "Developer tools".

platform.description: An agent or platform the listing says it works with, e.g. "Cursor".

verifiedOnly.description: Only listings whose Agentic Protocol files passed the checker.

name: search_directory
title: Search RUAGENTIC
